description: Demand requirements for a region. New demand enters at a stated peak in its construction year and scales forward by a growth rate; `value_of_lost_load` and `unserved_demand_curve` price whatever portion goes unserved.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`).

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type to be used in PCM modeling.

conformity.description: Indicator of how the demand requirement should conform to the load profile of existing technologies in the system. Should only be used for new demand requirements.

growth_rate.description: The annual growth rate of the demand requirement, used to scale present-day loads into future projections. Should only be used for conforming loads. Units: 1.

new_demand_mw.description: The value of the peak demand to be used for new DemandRequirements. Units: MW.

new_construction_year.description: The year in which the new demand requirement will be installed. Should only be used for new demand requirements.

region.description: Location where the component applies. Can be a zone or node.

value_of_lost_load.description: Value of unserved load. Units: USD/MWh.

unserved_demand_curve.description: Piecewise curve to scale the cost of unserved load based on the value of lost load. Units: USD/MWh.

requirements.description: List of requirement IDs associated with the component.

title: DemandRequirement
